scripts.topic: AI Architect explained with intelligent language
scripts.titleZh: AI架构师到底在架构什么？
scripts.titleEn: What does an AI architect actually design?
scripts.hookZh: AI架构师不是只会画架构图的人。
scripts.hookEn: An AI architect does more than draw diagrams.
scripts.spokenScriptZh: AI架构师真正设计的，是智能怎么流动。第一步，目标是什么；第二步，数据从哪里来；第三步，模型什么时候该回答，什么时候该调用工具；最后，把反馈写回系统。会画图只是表面，能让业务、数据、模型和工具形成闭环，才是AI架构师的价值。
scripts.englishSubtitle: An AI architect designs how intelligence moves through goals, data, models, tools, and feedback loops.
onScreenText: 目标 -> 数据 -> 模型 -> 工具 -> 反馈
shotList: 0-3s: Anime AI architect hero image with strong hook.
8-14s: Show question two: data source and context.
14-22s: Show model/tool orchestration as a flowing system.
22-32s: Show the final closed-loop architecture and CTA.
scripts.avatarCue: Use cartoon/anime AI architect visual as the presenter. No real-person likeness.
scripts.screenCue: Show a glowing intelligent language architecture pipeline: goal, data, model, tools, feedback.

caption.zh: AI架构师不是只会画图的人，而是设计智能如何在系统里流动的人。
caption.en: An AI architect designs how intelligence flows through a system.

cta.zh: 关注我，下一条拆AI架构师的工作流。
cta.en: Follow for the next AI architect workflow breakdown.
